services.name: Educator's Night
services.desc: K-12 Teachers and Administrators are invited to an Educator’s Night at the Elmhurst Art Museum. At this free event, educators will enjoy a tour of the current exhibition and a preview of the exhibitions that will be on view for school field trips in the 2026-2027 academic year. Learn about how to arrange a field trip to EAM with your students (some school groups visit for free!) and how our upcoming exhibitions connect to content you are teaching in class. Also, be among the first to learn about our new teen program launching this fall!
